verdict.rationale: ANEF is a digital-administration portal, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only a keyless JavaScript shell with every transaction behind an account, plus a Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site. Nothing documents any API, API keys, or least-privilege credentials for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
